title: kate-core: Selections (multi-cursor set), grapheme-aware movement, edit fan-out
summary: One cursor is a selection set of size one; there is no single-cursor code path. Selections is a sorted, non-overlapping Vec<Selection> with a primary index. Movement is grapheme-cluster aware and keeps a goal column across vertical moves. Fan-out builds one Transaction from a per-selection edit function, so typing with 40 cursors is one undo entry. Vertical movement here is by logical line; visual-line movement under dynamic wrap belongs to the GUI, which knows the layout.

lane.reason: Pure logic over kate-text with property tests for the sorted/non-overlapping invariant. No GUI involved.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: New crate API. Dependencies with justification: unicode-segmentation 1.13 (grapheme cursor for movement; char stepping splits emoji and combining marks), proptest (dev only). Selections::new turns an empty list into one caret at 0. A primary index past the end uses the last range. It never panics. Normalize uses half-open overlap. Carets at the same offset merge. A caret at a range's max stays separate, and touching ranges stay separate. A merge keeps the primary's direction and goal_col. transformed maps any pre-state transaction in O(selections + edits), using the transform_offset bias (anchor Left, head Right). The own-edit rule applies only when an edit exactly covers its selection. goal_col is kept. fan_out clamps ends, and returns TransactionError when the caller builds overlapping edits. Built-in deletes never error. They drop a fully contained delete and trim a partial overlap. Mixed range-and-caret sets delete at every selection, which differs from Kate keyDelete. The vertical goal is tab-expanded with tab_width (0 means 1), and every other scalar has width 1. Short lines clamp to the line end and keep goal_col. Up on the first line and Down on the last stay on that line. Vertical moves and LineEnd snap to grapheme and CRLF boundaries. Word movement follows KTextEditor v6.31.0 with camel-cursor off: Unicode alphanumerics plus _, with the default delimiters. Grapheme steps use GraphemeCursor over rope chunks with pre-context. They are capped at 256 scalars and match full segmentation below that cap. Delete and insert clear goal_col. With 20k carets, insert, replace, backspace and Right on a 40k-character line each take about 10 ms or less in release. No full-text copy per move.

regression_tests.name: selection::tests::normalize_sorts_merges_and_keeps_primary
regression_tests.asserts: For random selection vectors, the result is sorted by min(), no two ranges overlap, and the primary points at the range that absorbed the original primary.

regression_tests.name: movement::tests::right_steps_over_grapheme_clusters
regression_tests.asserts: From offset 0 in 'e\u{301}x' one Right lands after the combining mark (offset 2), not between e and the accent.

regression_tests.name: movement::tests::vertical_move_keeps_goal_column_across_short_lines
regression_tests.asserts: Column 10 on line 0, Down over an empty line, Down again lands on column 10 of line 2 (with tabs expanded at tab_width).

regression_tests.name: fanout::tests::typing_with_many_cursors_is_one_transaction
regression_tests.asserts: insert_text with 40 carets yields one Transaction of 40 edits and 40 carets each advanced by the text length; single caret is the same code path with 1 edit.
